turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Come, Your Majesty, let us proceed directly to the matter at hand. What is it that you require my assistance with, and what is the nature of the scandal that threatens the House of Ormstein?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that the scandal in question, Mr. Holmes, may have far-reaching consequences, not just for my family, but for the stability of Europe itself.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that your presence here is a matter of great significance, and I'm eager to understand the nature of the crisis that has brought you to us.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I entrust you both with the utmost confidentiality, for the sake of my family and the future of Europe, I must reveal that the scandal revolves around my daughter, Irene Adler, a woman of great cunning and intelligence, who has...

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must admit, I have heard of Irene Adler. Her reputation precedes her, and I am intrigued by her connection to the scandal you have described.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that my daughter's involvement in this matter may be more than mere coincidence, Mr. Holmes. Her...indiscretions, I suppose, have put our entire family at risk.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must admit, I find the situation both fascinating and disturbing. The involvement of a woman of Irene Adler's caliber in a matter of this gravity suggests a level of complexity that I am eager to unravel.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must confess, Your Majesty, that I find it quite astonishing that a woman of such caliber as Irene Adler would be involved in a matter that could potentially jeopardize the security of a European monarchy.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to understand that my family's honor and security are at stake. I implore you to keep our conversation entirely confidential, for if this were to become public knowledge, it could lead to...irreparable consequences.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must stress that discretion is not a virtue I possess, Your Majesty. However, I can assure you that the information you share with us will remain confidential, at least for the time being.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear I have already spoken too much, gentlemen. I must confess, the thought of my daughter's safety and the future of my dynasty weigh heavily upon me.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: May I inquire, Your Majesty, as to the specific nature of the threat to your daughter's safety and the future of your dynasty?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am at your mercy, gentlemen, and I fear that the longer I tarry, the more precarious my situation becomes.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I observe that you, Your Majesty, are an expert in disguise, but an amateur in subtlety. Please, proceed to the heart of the matter, that we may better understand the nature of the threat.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that I fear my own brother, Herr von Meininger, may be behind this dastardly plot, and I dare not confront him directly lest I compromise my own safety and that of my daughter.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must express my concern for the safety of your daughter, Your Majesty, and I would like to know more about Herr von Meininger's motivations and any evidence you may have against him.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must implore you, gentlemen, to exercise the utmost discretion in this matter, for the honor of my family and the stability of Europe itself are at stake.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Your Majesty, I deduce that the presence of the photograph in your pocket is more than mere coincidence. It is a thread that we can follow to unravel the tangled web of intrigue.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to handle this matter with all due haste, for the longer it takes to uncover the truth, the greater the danger to my daughter and, I fear, to the entire continent.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must inquire further about the nature of this photograph and its significance in relation to your brother's alleged involvement. May I ask, did you recognize the location depicted in the photograph, and is there any particular reason you believe Herr von Meininger would be interested in it?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
